title: FBI-UAP-D012, Newark Field Office, 1952-1967
what_is_it: A collection of FBI memoranda and correspondence documenting a special inquiry into UFO sightings reported in and near New Jersey over a 15-year period.
interpretation_warnings: No extracted body text was available; all facts are derived solely from document metadata and the CSV description provided by war.gov.
The original PDF appears to be scanned with poor or no OCR, so specific details such as named witnesses, exact sighting descriptions, and classified assessments could not be extracted.
Redaction level is estimated as moderate based on typical FBI documents of this era, but cannot be precisely assessed without readable page content.
Single-agency source: the FBI's perspective may differ from Air Force or other agency assessments of the same sightings.

verifiable_claims.claim: The FBI Newark Field Office conducted a special inquiry into UFO sightings in and near New Jersey between August 1952 and January 1967.
